entities.name: Griselbrand
entities.description: Most powerful of Innistrad's demons and one of Liliana Vess's demonic masters; killed by her with the Chain Veil.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who made a demonic pact with Griselbrand and later killed him.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Archangel of Innistrad who imprisoned the demons in the Helvault.

entities.name: Helvault
entities.description: Silver artifact of immense power used to imprison Innistrad's demons.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: Artifact Liliana used to kill Griselbrand.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane where Griselbrand ruled among demons.

entities.name: Sundering of the Helvault
entities.description: Breaking of the Helvault forced by Liliana.

entities.name: Mask of Griselbrand
entities.description: Mask worn by Griselbrand's cultists that imbues the wearer with the demon's powers.

events.summary: Griselbrand challenges Avacyn to combat; after days of battle she drives him into the Helvault, he impales her with his spear, and both are imprisoned by the rebounding binding spell.
Liliana forces the Sundering of the Helvault by pressuring Thalia, freeing Griselbrand.
events.quote: she forced the Sundering of the Helvault by forcing an ultimatum on Thalia, its guardian

events.summary: Freed, Griselbrand escapes Avacyn; Liliana tracks him down, corners him, sees through his promises and kills him permanently with the Chain Veil.
events.quote: used the Chain Veil to kill him permanently

relations.quote: used the Chain Veil to kill him permanently
resulting in both Griselbrand and Avacyn being imprisoned

relations.note: demonic master who granted her power over death; pact enslaving her soul
relations.quote: Griselbrand was one of the demonic masters of Liliana Vess .
